verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              तमायान्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य वेलोद्वृत्तमिवार्णवम् । गर्जन्तं सुमहाकायं दुर्निवारं सुरैरपि ॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Vasudeva the foremost of men beholding the great bodied Karna whom the gods could not advancing with roars like the swelling ocean said to Arjuna with a smile. There comes the chariot (of Karna) with gray steeds and Shalya its driver.

verses.sanskrit: अर्जुनं प्राह दाशार्हः प्रहस्य पुरुषर्षभः । अयं सरथ आयाति श्वेताश्वः शल्यसारथिः ॥२॥
येन ते सह योद्धव्यं स्थिरो भव धनञ्जय । पश्य चैनं समायुक्तं रथं कर्णस्य पाण्डव ॥३॥
verses.english: O Dhananjaya! With the intention of meeting you in battle so wait with calmness. O son of Pandu, look how beautifully the car of Karna is adorned; the son of Radha is on it.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतवाजिसमायुक्तं युक्तं राधासुतेन च । नानापताकाकलिलं किङ्किणीजालमालिनम् ॥४॥
verses.english: It has four beautiful gray horses and it is also decked with various sorts of banners and net work of bells and how it is being borne as if in the skies by their pale horses. Look the high souled Karna's banner with the sign of elephant rope.

verses.sanskrit: उह्यमानमिवाकाशे विमानं पाण्डुरैर्हयैः । ध्वजं च पश्य कर्णस्य नागकक्षं महात्मनः ॥५॥
आखण्डलधनुःप्रख्यमुल्लिखन्तमिवाम्बरम् । पश्य कर्णं समायान्तं धार्तराष्ट्रप्रियैषिणम् ॥६॥
verses.english: The banner like clouds and resembles the bow of Akhandal (Indra) which divides the sky and earth. See how Karna sends hosts of arrows like clouds pouring down rain as he is advancing fulfill the intention of Dhritarashtra's son.

verses.sanskrit: शरधारा विमुञ्चन्तं धारासारमिवाम्बुदम् । एष मद्रेश्वरो राजा रथाग्रे पर्यवस्थितः ॥७॥
नियच्छति हयानस्य राधेयस्यामितौजसः । शृणु दुन्दुभिनिर्घोषं शङ्खशब्दं च दारुणम् ॥८॥
verses.english: The king of Madra (Shalya) is seated on the front of the car and guiding the horses of the powerful Radha's son.

verses.sanskrit: सिंहनादांश्च विविधाञ्शृणु पाण्डव सर्वतः । अन्तर्धाय महाशब्दान् कर्णेनामिततेजसा ॥९॥
verses.english: to Hear, O son of Pandu, the noise of their tumtums and the shrill note of their conchs and lion-like roars that are coming from all directions.

verses.sanskrit: दोधूयमानस्य भृशं धनुषः शृणु निःस्वनम् । एते दीर्यन्ति सगणाः पञ्चालानां महारथाः ॥१०॥
verses.english: Karna, of unfathomable prowess, has drawn his bow and its loud twang can be heard above all other sounds.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा केसरिणं क्रुद्धं मृगा इव महावने । सर्वयत्नेन कौन्तेय हन्तुमर्हसि सूतजम् ॥११॥
verses.english: As in a forest a wrathful lion scares away herd of deers so the mighty Panchala warriors are melting (before Karna).

verses.sanskrit: न हि कर्णशरानन्यः सोढुमुत्सहते नरः । सदेवासुरगन्धर्वांस्त्रील्लोঁकान्सचराचरान् ॥१२॥
verses.english: O son of Kunti, you are the only person who would venture to bear the brunt of his weapons, so you should take all possible measures to kill him.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि जेतुं रणे शक्तस्तथैव विदितं मम । भीममुग्रं महात्मानं त्र्यक्षं शर्वं कपर्दिनम् ॥१३॥
verses.english: I know well that you are capable to conquer in battle all the three worlds together with its mobile and immobile creations and the gods and Gandharvas.

verses.sanskrit: न शक्ता द्रष्टुमीशानं किं पुनर्योधितुं प्रभुम् । त्वया साक्षान्महादेवः सर्वभूतशिवः शिवः ॥१४॥
verses.english: Nothing need be told about fighting; men cannot look towards the great god the three eyed and terrible Sarva, also called the Kaparddin. You have satisfied in battle that god of gods the Siva, deity Sthanu, the creator of the happiness of all creatures. O Partha, as Indra slew Namuchi so you will, O, you of powerful arms, by the kindness of the great god who is armed with trident, kill Karna and be victorious; and may it farewell with you.

verses.sanskrit: युद्धेनाराधितः स्थाणुर्देवाश्च वरदास्तव । तस्य पार्थ प्रसादेन देवदेवस्य शूलिनः ॥१५॥
जहि कर्णं महाबाहो नमुचिं वृत्रहा यथा । श्रेयस्तेऽस्तु सदा पार्थ युद्धे जयमवाप्नुहि ॥१६॥

अर्जुन उवाच।
              ध्रुव एव जयः कृष्ण मम नास्त्यत्र संशयः । सर्वलोकगुरुर्यस्त्वं तुष्टोऽसि मधुसूदन ॥१७॥
verses.english: Arjuna said O Krishna, you are the destroyer of Madhu and master of all creation; and as you are kind to me my victory in this battle is sure.

verses.sanskrit: चोदयाश्वान् हृषीकेश रथं मम महारथ । नाहत्वा समरे कर्णं निवर्तिष्यति फाल्गुनः ॥१८॥
verses.english: O Hrishikesa, a mighty warrior, urge on the horses and advance with my car. Phalgun will kill Karna.

verses.sanskrit: अद्य कर्णं हतं पश्य मच्छरैः शकलीकृतम् । मां वा द्रक्ष्यसि गोविन्द कर्णेन निहतं शरैः ॥१९॥
verses.english: O Govinda, today either I will slay Karna and hack him to pieces with my weapons or he will see me killed by his arrows.

verses.sanskrit: उपस्थितमिदं घोरं युद्धं त्रैलोक्यमोहनम् । यज्जनाः कथयिष्यन्ति यावद्भूमिर्धरिष्यति ॥२०॥
verses.english: You will soon witness the fight that will bewilder the three worlds and it will be spoken of till the world ends.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ब्रुवंस्तदा पार्थः कृष्णमक्लिष्टकारिणम् । प्रत्युद्ययौ रथेनाशु गजं प्रतिगजो यथा ॥२१॥
verses.english: Thus speaking to Krishna of inexhaustible energy, Partha advanced towards Karna like one elephant against another.

verses.sanskrit: पुनरप्याह तेजस्वी पार्थः कृष्णमरिन्दम । चोदयाश्वान् हृषीकेश कालोऽयमतिवर्तते । एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन पाण्डवेन महात्मना ॥२२॥
verses.english: Partha of great prowess again told Krishna who was the scorcher of foes "O Hrishikesa, time flies, so spur on the steeds".

verses.sanskrit: जयेन संपूज्य स पाण्डवं तदा प्रचोदयामास हयान्मनोजवान् । स पाण्डुपुत्रस्य रथो मनोजवः क्षणेन कर्णस्य रथाग्रतोऽभवत् ॥२३॥
verses.english: Thus addressed by the noble son of Pandu Kesava who wishes him victory lashed the steeds which were swift as the mind and very quickly brought the car of Pandu's son before Karna's chariot. steeds which were swift as the mind and very quickly brought the car of Pandu's son before Karna's chariot.
